review.summary: One low-severity Metrics toolbar-spacing mismatch was identified.

findings.summary: The sort-to-date control spacing exceeds the requested space-3 gap.
findings.rationale: The toolbar already supplies space-2 between adjacent controls, while an additional space-16 margin produces a 72px gap rather than the requested 12px total.
findings.recommendation: Use an additional space-1 margin so the shared space-2 gap totals space-3.
